017package org.apache.juneau.http.header;
018
019
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils.*;
022
023import java.util.*;
024import java.util.function.*;
025
026/**
027 * Base for simple comma-separated token lists.
028 *
029 * @since 9.2.1
030 */
031@SuppressWarnings({
032   "java:S2160", // equals() on HttpHeaderBean uses name + getValue(); typed state is reflected in getValue()
033   "unchecked" // Supplier<?> branches cast to typed suppliers after lazy-mode check
034})
035public class HttpCsvHeader extends HttpHeaderBean {
036
037   public static final int LAZY_WIRE_STRING = 0;
038   public static final int LAZY_TOKENS = 1;
039
040   private final String[] eagerTokens;
041   private final Supplier<?> lazySupplier;
042   private final int lazyMode;
043
044   /**
045    * Creates an {@link HttpCsvHeader} by parsing the given comma-delimited wire value.
046    *
047    * @param name Header name. Must not be {@code null}.
048    * @param wireValue Wire value. May be {@code null} or empty.
049    * @return A new instance. Never {@code null}.
050    */
051   public static HttpCsvHeader of(String name, String wireValue) {
052      return new HttpCsvHeader(name, wireValue);
053   }
054
055   /**
056    * Creates an {@link HttpCsvHeader} with the given typed values.
057    *
058    * @param name Header name. Must not be {@code null}.
059    * @param typedValues The token values. May be {@code null}.
060    * @return A new instance. Never {@code null}.
061    */
062   public static HttpCsvHeader of(String name, String...typedValues) {
063      return new HttpCsvHeader(name, typedValues);
064   }
065
066   /**
067    * Constructor.
068    *
069    * @param name Header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
070    * @param value Wire value. Can be <jk>null</jk> or empty, in which case the parsed tokens are <jk>null</jk>.
071    */
072   protected HttpCsvHeader(String name, String value) {
073      super(name, value);
074      this.eagerTokens = null;
075      this.lazySupplier = null;
076      this.lazyMode = -1;
077   }
078
079   /**
080    * Constructor.
081    *
082    * @param name Header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
083    * @param values The token values. Can be <jk>null</jk>, in which case the parsed tokens are <jk>null</jk>.
084    */
085   protected HttpCsvHeader(String name, String... values) {
086      super(name, values == null || values.length == 0 ? null : join(values, ", "));
087      this.eagerTokens = values == null ? null : cp(values);
088      this.lazySupplier = null;
089      this.lazyMode = -1;
090   }
091
092   /**
093    * Constructor with lazy value supplier.
094    *
095    * @param name Header name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
096    * @param supplier The lazy value supplier. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
097    * @param lazyMode Either {@link #LAZY_WIRE_STRING} or {@link #LAZY_TOKENS}.
098    */
099   protected HttpCsvHeader(String name, Supplier<?> supplier, int lazyMode) {
100      super(name, lazyMode == LAZY_WIRE_STRING
101         ? ((Supplier<String>) supplier)::get
102         : () -> {
103            var t = ((Supplier<String[]>) supplier).get();
104            if (t == null)
105               return null;
106            return join(t, ", ");
107         });
108      this.eagerTokens = null;
109      this.lazySupplier = supplier;
110      this.lazyMode = lazyMode;
111   }
112
113   public Optional<String[]> asArray() {
114      return o(cp(csvTokens()));
115   }
116
117   public Optional<List<String>> asList() {
118      return o(u(l(csvTokens())));
119   }
120
121   public boolean contains(String val) {
122      var t = csvTokens();
123      if (t == null)
124         return false;
125      for (var v : t)
126         if (eq(v, val))
127            return true;
128      return false;
129   }
130
131   public boolean containsIgnoreCase(String val) {
132      var t = csvTokens();
133      if (t == null)
134         return false;
135      for (var v : t)
136         if (eqic(v, val))
137            return true;
138      return false;
139   }
140
141   /**
142    * Returns the comma-delimited wire-format value of this header.
143    *
144    * @return The wire value, or <jk>null</jk> if the value is unset.
145    */
146   @Override
147   public String getValue() {
148      var t = csvTokens();
149      return t == null ? null : join(t, ", ");
150   }
151
152   /**
153    * Returns the parsed tokens of this header, or the specified default if unset.
154    *
155    * @param other The default value. Can be <jk>null</jk> to allow a <jk>null</jk> result when the header is unset.
156    * @return The parsed tokens, or <c>other</c> if the value is unset. Can be <jk>null</jk> if <c>other</c> is <jk>null</jk>.
157    */
158   public String[] orElse(String[] other) {
159      var x = csvTokens();
160      return nn(x) ? cp(x) : other;
161   }
162
163   /**
164    * Returns the parsed tokens of this header.
165    *
166    * @return The parsed tokens, or <jk>null</jk> if the value is unset.
167    */
168   public String[] toArray() {
169      return cp(csvTokens());
170   }
171
172   public List<String> toList() {
173      return u(l(csvTokens()));
174   }
175
176   private String[] csvTokens() {
177      if (lazyMode == LAZY_TOKENS)
178         return ((Supplier<String[]>) lazySupplier).get();
179      if (eagerTokens != null)
180         return eagerTokens;
181      return splita(super.getValue());
182   }
183}
